q: Our company runs a guest house for visiting staff. Which scope do its emissions go in?
title: Company guest house emissions
short: If you own or lease it and pay its bills, it sits inside your operational control: its electricity is Scope 2 and its LPG and diesel are Scope 1. If staff stay in hotels you pay for, that is Scope 3 business travel instead.

ul: Electricity bill in your name or paid by you: Scope 2.
LPG cylinders for the kitchen, diesel for a backup genset: Scope 1.
Refrigerant top-ups for its air conditioners: Scope 1.

p: Hotel nights booked for staff are Category 6. A flat provided by a landlord who pays the bills may be a leased asset; see who controls the meter.

senseible: Senseible reads quantities, dates and units from your bills and invoices and shows the factor and source used on every line.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
